name: P4-B validation / final-training policy screen (bounded, paired, 5-session cadence)
status: FROZEN before any P4-B fit; not launched
label: BURNED METHODOLOGY DIAGNOSTIC - selects a training methodology on the burned 2026-H1 interval; NOT independent OOS validation; all absolute numbers remain SURVIVOR-UNIVERSE / UNADJUSTED-PRICE references
question: Does the CURRENT validation policy (newest ~10% of matured dates held out, early stop on its IC, no refit on train+val) select worse models than a recent, shorter validation block, or than calibrating the epoch count and then training on train+validation?

held_constant.cadence: 5-session full refit (27 refits over the interval) - fixed for ALL policies; P0 showed 5-session ~= daily at the portfolio level
held_constant.early_stop_rule_where_used: argmax val rank IC, patience 3, min 2, max 25
held_constant.execution: T+1 close -> T+21 close label convention (next-open validated)

A_current.definition: matured_train_val: validation = newest 10% of matured dates (~260 sessions, contiguous, ending 21 sessions before the refit); train = all older matured dates ending 21 sessions before validation; early stop on validation IC; final weights = best-validation epoch; NO refit on train+val
A_current.fits: REUSED from P0 arm B cache (identical function, seeds, dates, config hash) - 0 new fits

B_recent126.definition: validation = the most recent 126 matured sessions (contiguous, ending 21 sessions before the refit); train = all matured dates ending 21 sessions before the validation block; early stop on validation IC; final = best-validation epoch; no refit on train+val

C_recent63.definition: as B with a 63-session validation block

D_calibrate_then_train_all.definition: step 1 = policy B's fit (reused): E = 1 + index of the best-validation epoch. step 2 = retrain the SAME seed from scratch on TRAIN + VALIDATION (policy B's blocks, i.e. every matured date up to 21 sessions before the refit) for a fixed budget of E epochs with early stopping disabled (patience = 1e6, min_epochs = max_epochs = E). Implementation note: production fit_one always restores the epoch with the best IC on the rows passed as validation; step 2 passes the (now in-sample) validation rows, so the restored epoch is the best in-sample-IC epoch among the E epochs - in practice the last or near-last epoch. This is documented as an approximation of 'exactly E epochs'; an inert restore_best=False kwarg in fit_one would make it exact and is proposed for review, NOT applied. No information after the refit date is used at any step.

epoch_diagnostic_P4_B0.definition: on 9 evenly spaced refit dates x 3 seeds under policy A's split, train with early stopping DISABLED for 15 epochs and, after every epoch, score (a) validation IC, (b) train loss, (c) the refit's 5-session OOS block IC (research-only; never used for selection). Implemented by wrapping predict_idx inside the research process only - production code untouched. Reports: per-epoch curves, correlation(val IC, later OOS IC) across epochs, regret = OOS IC at the validation-best epoch minus OOS IC at the ex-post best epoch, and OOS IC at a fixed epoch near the median early-stop point (6)
epoch_diagnostic_P4_B0.fits: 27 fits x 15 epochs (~2.5x a normal fit)

primary: Spearman(val IC, subsequent block OOS IC) across refits, raw and time-detrended
metrics.paired: all per-date metrics differenced against policy A on identical dates; HAC(20) SE

decision_thresholds.PROMISING (a policy may proceed to a 7-s: vs A on the same dates: dIC >= +0.005 AND dIC > +1 HAC SE AND positive-IC frequency >= A - 2pp AND spread >= A - 0.2pp AND val->OOS Spearman (time-detrended) >= A's + 0.30 or >= 0 AND d turnover <= +0.05 AND d max_dd <= +1.0pp AND all three seeds individually dIC >= 0
decision_thresholds.NOT_PROMISING: dIC <= -0.005 or fails two or more of the secondary/portfolio checks
decision_thresholds.VALIDATION_POLICY_INCONCLUSIVE: anything else; no winner is selected
decision_thresholds.note: thresholds frozen before the run; a +0.001 IC difference is noise; Sharpe-like metrics never decisive

compute.estimated_gpu_hours: B/C/D 243 x 52.9 s = 3.6 h; epoch diagnostic 27 x ~130 s = 1.0 h; total ~4.6 h (~5.5 h at the p90 70 s/fit)
compute.schedule_rule: start only after tonight's daily_ops has completed and the GPU is idle; must not overlap the next production window
